manual_migration_required.title: Manual Upgrade Required for Panasonic AC India
manual_migration_required.description: Panasonic AC India introduces independent per-device entries and local IR blaster support. Auto-migration could not split your legacy account entry automatically. Please delete the old entry under Settings -> Devices & Services -> Panasonic AC India and re-add your account via Add Integration. All your existing entity names, automations, and dashboards will remain unchanged.

migration_successful.title: Migrated to Panasonic AC India — Device Settings Available
migration_successful.description:
Your Panasonic AC integration has been successfully updated!

Each AC unit is now managed as an independent device entry with hybrid Cloud + IR support.

To set up local IR control or hybrid failover for your AC unit:
1. Go to **Settings -> Devices & Services -> Panasonic AC India**.
2. Click the **Configure (Settings Cog)** button next to your AC device.
3. Configure your **IR Blaster**, **IR Receiver**, or control preferences.
